images.alt: A political cartoon by Megan Herbert showing a panel split into two parts. On the left: The title "Things One Nation Doesn't Want*, below which is a a word cloud in the shape of Australia listing in array of bright colours some of the policies, cultures, foodstuffs, institutions, people and objects One Nation opposes or wants removed from Australia, to be replaced by their amorphous idea of a 'monoculture'. Below this image is a disclaimer: "*Not a complete list". On the right: The title "Things One Nation Wants" below which is nothing. Just a big, blank, very white void.
